scope: Finite external read-only H/D/offline ZIP fixture construction, independent payload equality and servicing previews. No native installer carrier, installed-state authority or release qualification.

roles.H: Product-bound payload-free native read-only source-consumer fixture; contains neither D nor S and embeds no final D/S digest.
roles.D: The exact separately qualified dev.36 DiskEd executable; this fixture does not embed H or alter D.
roles.S: Stored offline ZIP fixture containing H, D and a metadata manifest. This is not a qualified native Setup carrier.

required_checks: Compile and launch the product-bound H using exact original CoreStatic inputs under DiskEd-owned CMake; preserve clean source identity and raw native evidence.
Build S only into a new owned fixture root from separate original D inventory/build-info and H artifact receipt; never execute or extract carrier content in the builder.
Verify the exact independent expected entry set and decoded bytes; reject missing/extra/replaced H or D even when internal and outer metadata are consistently rewritten.
Reject cycles, H containing D/S, D containing S, recursive own/ancestor hashes and an embedded-H claim for this external fixture.
Existing roots and partial failures retain foreign/case/evidence/recovery data; no cleanup or replay claim.
An independently retained H can launch and inspect source structure when a disposable copy of D is corrupt; this establishes an inspection route, not repair or recovery success.

Servicing previews require one matching owner, exact generations and a complete current dependency capture. Active, unresolved, unreachable, stale, uncertain or recovery-required dependencies defer retirement.
Cancellation requests are not release proof. A terminal/exited observation still requires current complete closure, released resources and no recovery dependency.
Repair preserves accepted selections/exclusions and policy; external tools and case/configuration/evidence/recovery data never acquire payload ownership.
Provider withdrawal denies proposed new admission while retaining dependency-required generations. Eligible preview never grants execution authority and always requires an atomic live recheck.
